messages:
alex: Heads up — nightly perf spike after upgrading to CUDA 12.5.2 + torch 2.5. Small-batch (1-4 tokens) p50 latency up ~38% on A100 dedicated pool.

ci-bot: perf/regressions/kv-cache small-batch: p50 +38% p95 +45% link: https://ci.internal/reports/171800

nora: Did we also pick up a Triton or kernel lib bump in the build? Any changed kernel hints?

sam: We rolled triton -> 2.3.1 in the same job. Bisect started but initial runs point at matmul path selection, not scheduler.

luca: Profiler snapshot shows matmul op landing on 'generic_matmul' kernel instead of 'mma_tile_optimized'. Shape (B=1, M=64, N=64, K=4096) triggers heuristic change.

luca: Profiler lines:
```
op matmul@step=1024 shape=(1,64,4096) kernel=generic_matmul time=0.84ms
op matmul@step=1024 shape=(4,64,4096) kernel=mma_tile_optimized time=0.32ms
```

nora: That smells like a cuBLAS/cuTensor or alignment heuristic in CUDA 12.5.2. Sam, can you try forcing the tile hint locally?

sam: Tried local env override: setting TRITON_MATMUL_HINT=force_mma fixes p50 in microbench to baseline. Will open a temporary PR to inject the hint for small-batch shapes.

alex: Thanks. Can we canary that on 2 nodes in dedicated? If that removes the regression we ship hotfix and follow up with vendor bug report.

infra-bot: canary deploy started: infra/canary-a100-2nodes by alex

ci-bot: post-canary microbench: small-batch p50 -2% vs baseline (within noise). Full perf suite running.

sam: Filed PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4212 — adds kernel hint for shapes where B<=4 and K>=1024. Includes tests + metrics.

nora: Also filing an issue with NVIDIA with the minimal repro. We should include the profiler and disassembly.

alex: Good. We'll hold the release until canary passes and then ship hotfix. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
